constructs_or_stages_outcome: urine albumin is the albuminuria limb of the KDIGO definition (ACR >=30 mg/g is the first-listed marker of kidney damage)
evidence: KDIGO 2024 defines CKD by GFR <60 OR a marker of kidney damage, of which albuminuria (ACR >=30 mg/g) is the first listed. The released column is a semiquantitative reagent-strip grade, not a measured ACR: dipstick protein is a crude, concentration-dependent proxy that detects mainly albumin at higher grades and is not interchangeable with a quantified ratio. The incorporation risk is therefore real but weaker than for a measured ACR, and this distinction is why the variable has its own restricted configuration rather than being pooled with creatinine.
